text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hear Gold Ship's voice coming from the roof one day and decide to investigate.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Not to worry… You're safe now.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Once again, I've managed to protect the academy from the threat beyond the stars…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It sure took a lot out of me, though… Recovering is gonna take a while…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't know about the threat beyond the stars, but Gold Ship's exhaustion seems real. It takes her a while to get back in form.
